question: Can immense material wealth justify giving away this kaula teaching?
premises: One may possess wealth enough to fill the ocean with jewels
The verse sets up a comparison of value
inference: Even vast material wealth is implied to be insufficient compared to the value of the teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is textually problematic and may be corrupt
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels...
